purpose: Test the scientifically appropriate population-level sub-Mpc pair objective by aggregating pair moments across frozen train cubes before taking log ratios, thereby separating ensemble structure error from individual-cube cosmic variance.

immutable_queries_and_folds.source: all sixteen sealed V65 immutable train queries per domain in their sealed order

rank_and_pair_probe.rank_source: the first eight members of the corresponding source_balanced V65 donor mapping
rank_and_pair_probe.rank8_population_reproduction: the maximum absolute full-population log-ratio difference from the sealed V65 rank16 value over all domains and separations is at most ln(1.25)

population_objective.construction: for each domain and separation, arithmetic-mean predicted pair moments and arithmetic-mean truth pair moments across the objects in the fold, then take their natural-log ratio
population_objective.score: one half the equal-weight mean squared population log ratio across three domains and three separations
population_objective.gradient: exact final-output-layer weight-plus-bias gradient assembled from each object's predicted-pair-moment Jacobian before any optimizer step
population_objective.bounded_NLL_reference: equal-weight mean final-output-layer bounded-NLL gradient across the same fold objects

selection_rules.population_value_stable: rank8 full-population reproduction passes and the maximum absolute fold-minus-full population log-ratio difference over all domains and separations is at most ln(2)
selection_rules.population_gradient_coherent: all four fold pair-gradient cosines to their leave-one-out mean are strictly positive, their median is at least 0.5, and their negative fraction is zero
selection_rules.optimization_safe: in every fold the coefficient-0.1 pair-to-bounded-NLL gradient L2 ratio is in [0.01,100] and both first-order descent dot products for the bounded-NLL plus coefficient-0.1 pair update are strictly positive
selection_rules.select_population_pair_objective: value stability, gradient coherence, optimization safety, exact ancestry, numerical and memory integrity, and all firewalls pass

authorized_if_selected.future_objective_change: add coefficient 0.1 times the domain-balanced population pair score to the sealed V63 objective
